dialogOption.texten: 911, what's your emergency?
Uh... Hello. I don't really know how to say it, but...
I think my husband is a cook.
{WHAT DO YOU MEAN?}I am sorry what do you mean ma'am?
{DON'T YOU LIKE MEN WHO COOK WELL?}I thought women like men who can cook well.
I mean... I think that he makes drugs.
{WHY DO YOU THINK SO?} Oh. Why do you think so?
I found weird containers filled with some stuff in our cellar. They stink pretty bad... I have no idea what it is... My husband's a chemist but why would he need that...
{IT'S NOT A TV SHOW} Ma'am, maybe you've watched too many TV shows.
I'm serious...
{THAT'S NOT ENOUGH} That's not enough evidence, ma'am.
But he keeps in touch with some kid, I guess it's his former student. I think the police used to keep an eye on him. I'm not sure but it might've been connected to drugs...
{WHY ARE YOU CALLING?} Why do you call 911 on your husband?
We don't get along well. And I feel like my home is being observed lately... Some shady guys started to wander around in our neighborhood. I'm scared, I need to protect my son...
{CHECK THE CELLAR} Can you check what's inside the vessels? The kind of smells getting out of the containers?

dialogOption.texten: Yeah, sure... [pause, coughs] Uhh... It smells funny... Daaaaamn. I need you to send someone here... now....

{WHAT'S THE ADDRESS?} What's your address?
2608 Central Avenue
5603 Menaul Boulevard
156 Indian School Road
{I'LL SEND THE POLICE} I understand ma'am. I'll send an officer by to check it out. Where are you calling from?
{I'LL SEND THE POLICE}Ok, the patrol's on the way.
{I'LL SEND POLICE AND AMBULANCE} Hold on there ma'am, I'll send an officer and ambulance to you.
Just be quick...
{GO TO A POLICE STATION} In that case you should go to the nearest police station and talk to an officer there.
{GO TO A POLICE STATION} In that case you should go to the nearest police station and talk to an officer there. Bring some photos of the labels that are on the containers ok?
Okay, thank you...

reportElement.texten: A woman suspected that her husband was making drugs.
The woman got intoxicated by chemical fumes from the vessel.
The policemen found a drug lab in the cellar. The caller's husband confessed and was arrested.
It turned out that the caller was right about her husband. He figured out the situation and ran away.
